name: ec2-instance-connect:SendSSHPublicKey at the narrowest concrete instance scope still fires (scope boundary)
note: Even scoped to a single concrete instance ARN (no wildcard, so no WILDCARD-RESOURCE co-finding), the session-takeover primitive fires - the finding tracks the exec ACTION, not resource breadth. Boundary witness: the tightest scope that still fires.
rationale: ec2-instance-connect:SendSSHPublicKey pushes an SSH key to a specific instance; connecting then yields the instance role from IMDS. Scoping to one concrete instance ARN does not remove the primitive (and does not raise WILDCARD-RESOURCE), so COMPUTE-SESSION-TAKEOVER still fires at high - the resource-scope boundary does not gate the action-level risk.
